description: settings/render.json (gitignored per-machine render-backend preference; no data/ content file pairs with this schema - validate_data skips data/schemas/). Written ONLY by game/core/render_settings.py through engine.data_io.write_validated and read back through the same module, which returns the default backend rather than raising when the file is missing or unreadable. Read at BOOT only: an explicit --backend flag or HTBH_RENDER_BACKEND still wins.

backend.description: Which render stack to build at the next launch: 'gpu' (SDL2 texture), 'surface' (CPU blitter - the settings screen calls this CPU), or 'auto' (try GPU, fall back to Surface whole).

title: render_settings
